author: Young_Thugatron
quote: The game requires wise decision making and good positioning when approaching certain enemies and bosses; make a mistake and you will be overwhelmed and lose a lot of health fast. Dying is extra punishing because losing your human form will make you lose access to 50% of your health bar, and you will be locked to 50% unless you exit phantom form or use a certain ringm. Since it is a remake of the first souls game don't expect the same smooth controls from Dark Souls 3 or Elden Ring. Graphics are top tier and till this day the most impressive from the ps5 generation along side horizon forbidden west. Many of the bosses are gimmicky but some can be demanding and stand out which I won't spoil. There are many tools which can be used to overcome certain barriers but in the end this is still the typical fromsoftware garbage where many players end up following a guide or using a wiki to "git gud" because these bums even after decades of game development don't understand how to make a game with streamlined level design with concise navigation and emphasis on where to go, where to not go, and what weapon/armor will give an advantage on x scenario. Either way, there are games with better combat, world building, and bosses from the 2000s in comparison to this game.

author: Young_Thugatron
quote: Yeah the last of us part 2 had the best story I've ever played, it was an amazing game, if Ellie killed Abby she would have made the same mistake joel and Abby committed, as Abby's revenge didn't fix any if her personal problems going on internally and externally, in top of that ellies story mirror's nathan drakes pursued of treasure as nathan drake puts the people he cares about in danger for worthless treasure, in the end nathan leaves tge treasure in the past in order to care about his family, just like ellie leaves her revenge nehind. Abby's story mirror Joel's from the last of us part 1, the story starts with losing a loved one and growing as a person after meeting a little kid that sufferes from external and internal problens as lec lost his sister and ellie lost her best friend before meeting joel. Ellies decision in the end shows growth and selflessness as she acknowledges that every person makes decisions based on circumstance and how Abby has so much in common with joel and she would be committing the same action Abby committed that affect ellie  in the begging of the second game. Joel's decision in the end of part 1(2013) serves as an opposite to Peter's decision in the end of Marvel's spiderman(2018). It is all about putting other people's circumstances into consideration abd growing as a person and lifting your self abd the people around you rather than harming the world you were brought into.
game_title: The Last of Us Part II
